about_the_game:
Campaign Mode

Complete many different missions in Campaign Mode and save the space city from the pirates!
Only the first half hour of playtime is included in the Demo

Choose your class - Dominate the battlefield

In Ultima Nex, you duel with other players in action-packed space battles. Choose from five unique spaceship classes, each designed for different play styles
Only the first 3 space ships are included in the Demo

🔺Fighter - The perfect all-rounder, relatively fast, good damage and good defence!
🔺Fighter Jet - The fastest ship in the galaxy! Particularly annoying against any kind of ship, except...
🔺Interceptor - Particularly good against small, fast spaceships, with lots of small projectiles being fired at the same time!
🔺Battery - Nerve your opponents with large EMP waves that paralyse all players in the vicinity!
🔺Heavy Cannon - This spaceship has an extremely large cannon with it, which does immense damage and is therefore particularly good against tanks
🔺Shadow Hunter - A fast, annoying assassin, he is designed to surprise his opponents and eliminate them quickly

Different special abilities for each spaceship

Each spaceship has special abilities that offer different strategic possibilities to conquer the galaxy!

Game modes - Your path to galaxy domination

Ultima Nex offers various exciting game modes that provide excitement and variety:
Only the first two game modes are included in the Demo

🔺Deathmatch - Fight against the other team, but beware! There is no respawning!
🔺Space War - Fight against the other team, the team that defeats more opponents wins
🔺Core Defence - Protect your energy core, only it will allow you to respawn. Destroy the enemy team's core and then eliminate it completely, and victory is yours...
🔺Space Conquerors - Capture all of your opponent's space zones and defend your own!

A vast galaxy awaits you

From dense asteroid fields to abandoned space stations and huge planetary rings - every map in Ultima Nex brings new challenges and strategic opportunities. Use the terrain to your advantage, lay ambushes or flee into dangerous nebula clouds to escape your opponents.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or greater
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 or greater
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD RX 5700-XT / Intel Arc A750
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
